scope: Synthetic bounded measurement of the approved dated-diff raw-text projection reuse candidate. Only the migration dated-diff SELECT differs. No actual reader, complete validator invocation, writer, auth/RLS, or Supabase migration-chain performance measurement.

design.pairing: AB/BA alternating, sequential, single backend per case; warmups are not measured samples
design.plannerModes: forced custom and forced generic are distinct inputs; no mixed auto-plan samples or combined averages
design.inputFetch: synthetic JSON fixture fetch, not the actual operating reader
design.plans: none; EXPLAIN, PREPARE and large array SQL literals are excluded after the prior diagnostic OOM
design.timings: observations only; no machine-dependent latency pass threshold; direct phase timings only; no EXPLAIN
design.resultOrder: record encountered and sorted date hashes separately; a changed encounter order is never silently treated as exact equivalence

candidateApproval: Approved local dated-diff candidate comparison; no production deployment authorization. Complete validator behavior requires its separate regression suite.
